Subject: INV-4493 / INV-4494 — Outstanding remit and next steps

Hi Carlos,

Following up on the outstanding invoices (INV-4493, INV-4494). Our Treasury shows both attempted payments were rejected by your bank citing "entity mismatch / VAT registration" on INV-4494. Can you confirm the remittance entity and whether HelioHealth will remit net or gross (any WHT instructions)?

We'd like to avoid placing the account on credit hold — proposal below:
- Immediate partial payment for INV-4493 to remove urgent exposure (minimum USD 60k)
- Reissue INV-4494 to match your local VAT entity if required; we can do this same day once you confirm the correct billing entity and VAT number
- Formalize a staged remit timeline for the remainder (payment schedule to clear within 10 business days)

Please see the attached stub with suggested remit routing fields (Helio_Remit_Instructions.pdf). If helpful, I can loop in our Treasury and collections lead for a quick call.

Thanks,

Quick facts:
- Payment for INV-4493 attempted on 2026-10-28 but was returned due to beneficiary name mismatch (HelioHealth US vs HelioHealth Global).
- INV-4494 includes EU VAT charge that our AP needs tied to a European VAT-registered subsidiary. Our Treasury requests a reissued invoice that shows the EU entity (HelioHealth EU GmbH) and the correct VAT ID.
- We can do a partial wire today for INV-4493 (USD 62,500) once our bank confirms wire fields — please confirm account name exactly as you'd like it to appear.

I'll attach our internal remittance note. We want to clear this quickly but need the corrected invoice for tax/reclaim purposes.

—Carlos
